entries.title: Axiom Verge

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with Randomizer mode.

primary.version: Current PC release with Randomizer mode
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archival version because it has the complete game, the later official Randomizer mode update, and PC capture/settings flexibility. The Multiverse Edition is a strong physical collector package, especially on Switch with its extras, but it does not add exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Axiom Verge on Steam for Windows PC and use the current build. Use the Multiverse Edition only if you want the physical booklet/poster/documentary or soundtrack extras.
